title: [I've been home these past...
content_text:
[I've been home these past couple of days with a lot of time on my hands, and not much to do.]
呢两日都喺屋企，好多时间但又唔知做乜好。
[Same today — I finally got around to finishing Heidi, that movie I'd never managed to finish. It really is such a warm movie.]
今日都係咁——终于抽返时间，将套一直未睇完嘅《海蒂同爷爷》睇完咗。套戏真係好温暖。
[While watching it, I noticed something interesting: I love little girls, and if I ever have a daughter, I'd name her Heidi.]
睇嘅过程度发现咗件几有趣嘅事：我好钟意小女孩，第日如果有个女，我想同佢改名叫 Heidi。
[I also noticed something: the English title is just Heidi, but the Chinese title is literally "Heidi and Grandpa."]
仲发现咗一样嘢：套戏英文名就咁短，净係得 Heidi，但中文名就变咗《海蒂同爷爷》。
